faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about HydraWay

items.question: What is HydraWay?
items.answer: HydraWay is a premium electrolyte drink in soluble stick format. Each stick contains a balanced mix of sodium, potassium, magnesium, and vitamins for optimal hydration.

items.question: How many sticks can I take per day?
items.answer: We recommend 1 to 2 sticks per day. Dissolve one stick in 250 to 500 ml of cold water according to your taste preferences. Adjust your intake based on your activity level and weather conditions.

items.question: Does HydraWay contain sugar?
items.answer: No, HydraWay is sugar-free. Our formula is designed to provide effective hydration without the extra calories from sugar.

items.question: Is HydraWay suitable for vegans?
items.answer: Yes, HydraWay is gluten-free and suitable for vegan diets. No animal-derived ingredients are used in our formulation.

items.question: When should I use HydraWay?
items.answer: HydraWay is ideal for intense sport, hot weather days, recovery after a night out, or simply to maintain proper hydric balance in your daily life.

items.question: Where is HydraWay manufactured?
items.answer: HydraWay is manufactured in Tunisia in a production facility certified GMP (21 CFR Part 111) and FSSC 22000, ensuring the highest quality and food safety standards.

items.question: What are the delivery times?
items.answer: We deliver throughout Tunisia (all 24 governorates). Delivery times are generally 2 to 5 business days depending on your location.

items.question: What payment methods do you accept?
items.answer: We accept online payment via Flouci as well as Cash on Delivery (COD) for your convenience.

items.question: Is HydraWay a medication?
items.answer: No, HydraWay is a dietary supplement. It is not a medication and does not replace medical treatment. If in doubt, consult your doctor.

items.question: What does HydraWay taste like?
items.answer: HydraWay comes in a Red Berries flavor — a fresh, pleasant taste that dissolves instantly in cold water. No artificial aftertaste.
